IVX — COMPLETE CURRENT SECURITY / SOURCE / DEPLOYMENT ITEMS ONE BY ONE
MODE: EXECUTE ITEM-BY-ITEM
NO NEW GENERAL AUDIT
NO STALE SHA
NO NARRATIVE-ONLY COMPLETION
NO FAKE DEPLOYMENT
NO FAKE CERTIFICATION

CANONICAL REPOSITORY:
ibb142/ivx-holdings-platform

CANONICAL PR:
#192

CANONICAL FEATURE BRANCH:
fix/senior-certification-hard-gates

LAST VERIFIED GITHUB HEAD:
39a62c9a34f52d9db99ff96ef4cd95433ef15182

IMPORTANT:
Fetch current PR HEAD again before execution.
If it changed, use the new exact SHA.

==================================================
ITEM 1 — REPOSITORY SOURCE OF TRUTH
==================================================

Verify:

git remote -v
git branch --show-current
git rev-parse HEAD
git status --short

Then independently fetch from GitHub:

PR #192 HEAD
feature branch HEAD
main HEAD

Build this matrix:

LOCAL_RORK_SHA
GITHUB_FEATURE_SHA
GITHUB_MAIN_SHA
RENDER_PRODUCTION_SHA

Rules:

- GitHub canonical repo is authoritative.
- Rork local workspace is NOT authoritative if histories diverge.
- No force push.
- No blind cherry-pick.
- No deploy from local-only commits.
- No old SHA may be used for current certification.

PASS ITEM 1 only when repository identities are explicitly reconciled.

==================================================
ITEM 2 — PRESERVE PHASE 1 / 2 / 3
==================================================

Do NOT rebuild already-certified autonomous phases from scratch unless their
protected files changed after the certified SHA.

Expected current status:

PHASE 1:
Autonomous Governance = PASS

PHASE 2:
Agent Capability + Least Privilege = PASS

PHASE 3:
Autonomous Execution + QA Engine = PASS

Phase 3 verified contract includes:

- runtime path = executeAgentRun
- representative real executions
- negative controls
- real tool result IDs
- sourceReferences
- evidence SHA256
- simulated = false
- exact source SHA binding
- realFundsMoved = false
- blocked operations stay BLOCKED

Do not downgrade these protections.

==================================================
ITEM 3 — FIX PERSISTENCE VERIFICATION
==================================================

Phase 3 CI proved runtime execution but current live Supabase persistence
still needs independent verification.

Inspect live Supabase for:

ivx_agent_executions
ivx_agent_states
ivx_agent_alerts
ivx_agent_certificates

If dedicated tables are absent, inspect the documented durable fallback:

ivx_agent_jobs

Do not claim durable persistence unless actual Phase 3 records exist
in one of those stores.

Required durable fields:

taskId
runId
agentId
agentNumber
workflow
taskType
finalStatus
realToolUsed
toolsUsed
toolResultId
sourceReference
evidenceSha256
simulated
startedAt
finishedAt
durationMs

If persistence is not actually occurring:

FIX THE RUNTIME BINDING.

Do not ask owner for credentials first.

Test existing runtime bindings and return exact state:

BOUND_AND_VALID
PRESENT_BUT_UNAUTHORIZED
MISSING_BINDING
EXPIRED_OR_REVOKED
UNVERIFIED

Only request owner action after actual 401/403/missing proof.

==================================================
ITEM 4 — SUPABASE OWNER VARIABLES BINDING
==================================================

The Phase 3 CI log reported that the runner could not resolve the Owner
Variables database bridge.

Audit:

SUPABASE_ACCESS_TOKEN binding
SUPABASE_DB_URL binding
DATABASE_URL binding
POSTGRES_URL binding
SUPABASE_SERVICE_ROLE_KEY binding

DO NOT PRINT VALUES.

Determine exactly which layer lacks access:

GitHub Actions
backend runtime
Render runtime
Owner Variables bridge

If production runtime already has the variables, fix binding/lookup code.
Do NOT recreate credentials unnecessarily.

PASS requires either:

A)
persistenceConfigured=true and a real durable execution row is written

or

B)
documented backend fallback is proven with a real durable row.

==================================================
ITEM 5 — CURRENT WIRE SOURCE SECURITY
==================================================

Read from CURRENT canonical GitHub SHA:

backend/api/ivx-wire-transfer.ts
server.ts

Required source contract:

- full wire instructions require verified member auth
- submission requires verified member auth
- userId/email/name derived from JWT/server identity
- request body cannot select another user's identity
- reference code bound to authenticated user
- fake token denied
- anonymous request denied
- client cannot self-credit wallet

Do NOT overwrite current secure implementation with stale local Rork code.

==================================================
ITEM 6 — LIVE PRODUCTION WIRE SECURITY
==================================================

DO NOT MOVE FUNDS.

Against production execute:

A.
GET /api/ivx/wire-instructions
anonymous
EXPECTED: unauthorized / safe preview only
NO routing/account digits

B.
fake bearer
EXPECTED: 401/403

C.
POST /api/ivx/wire-submission
anonymous
EXPECTED: 401

D.
fake bearer
EXPECTED: 401/403

E.
USER_A authenticated, body userId=USER_B
EXPECTED:
server ignores/rejects USER_B
stored identity remains USER_A

F.
USER_B uses USER_A reference
EXPECTED: denied

If feature branch passes but production fails:

SOURCE_CODE = SECURE
PRODUCTION = STALE / VULNERABLE
DO NOT modify secure source backwards.

==================================================
ITEM 7 — RENDER DEPLOYMENT SOURCE
==================================================

Using current stored Render credential:

verify:

service ID
service name
repository
branch
autoDeploy
latest deploy ID
latest deployed commit
deploy status

Do not print API key.

Expected repository:

@[github:https%3A%2F%2Fgithub.com%2Fibb142%2Fivx-holdings-platform:GitHub Sync - ibb142/ivx-holdings-platform]

If Render tracks:

main

and feature PR is unmerged:

DO NOT pretend feature SHA is deployed.

Return:

MERGE_REQUIRED=true

unless an exact-SHA branch deploy path is explicitly supported and authorized.

==================================================
ITEM 8 — PRODUCTION SHA PARITY
==================================================

Call:

/health
/version

Record exact production SHA.

Required for deployment certification:

PRODUCTION_SHA == APPROVED_GITHUB_SHA

If not equal:

PRODUCTION_STALE=true
PRODUCTION_CERTIFIED=false

HTTP 200 alone is NOT deploy proof.

==================================================
ITEM 9 — APK / AAB SECRET CERTIFICATION
==================================================

Rebuild from CANONICAL GitHub SHA.

Produce:

artifact filename
artifact SHA256
source Git SHA
build workflow/run
build timestamp
files scanned
patterns scanned
forbidden_secret_matches

Search generated binary/bundle for:

GitHub write tokens
Render tokens
Supabase service_role
DB passwords
AI private API keys
Twilio auth tokens
AWS secret access key
owner system secrets
private keys

Allowed public client configuration includes:

Supabase publishable/anon key
public API URL
public project identifiers

Do not show secret values.

PASS:
forbidden_secret_matches = 0

A local APK built from a non-canonical commit is NOT sufficient.

==================================================
ITEM 10 — CREDENTIAL BINDING MATRIX
==================================================

Verify existing stored credentials only.

For:

GitHub
Render
Supabase
AI provider
Twilio
AWS

Return only:

BOUND_AND_VALID
PRESENT_BUT_UNAUTHORIZED
MISSING_BINDING
EXPIRED_OR_REVOKED
UNVERIFIED

Include sanitized HTTP status/error.

Do not call GitHub 401 a code failure.

Do not ask for replacement access until actual verification proves the current
credential cannot be used.

==================================================
ITEM 11 — CI ON CURRENT EXACT SHA
==================================================

Fetch ALL required CI runs for current PR HEAD.

Report:

Autonomous Governance
Least Privilege
Phase 3 Execution QA
Senior Quality Gate
Secret Leak Scanner
QA Suite
E2E Acceptance
Playwright
Maestro

Rules:

SUCCESS = PASS
FAILURE = FAIL
QUEUED = QUEUED
SKIPPED = SKIPPED
MISSING = MISSING

Never convert queued/skipped into PASS.

Historical failures from previous SHAs must be labeled HISTORICAL.

==================================================
ITEM 12 — MAESTRO
==================================================

If Maestro is queued:

do not call it PASS.

Fetch exact:

run ID
job ID
runner type
queue status

If possible, retry only after the prior run is no longer active.

If infrastructure capacity is the blocker:

MAESTRO = BLOCKED_INFRA

Continue every other item.

==================================================
ITEM 13 — GITHUB WRITE AUTH
==================================================

Test the existing GitHub credential/binding against canonical repo.

Required capability for final shipping:

read repo
write feature branch
update PR branch

If 401/403:

return exact sanitized error.

Do not replace or recreate token unless proven unusable.

Do not merge yet.

==================================================
ITEM 14 — PR STATE
==================================================

PR #192 currently expected:

open
draft
unmerged

Re-fetch.

If still draft/open:

keep working on feature branch.

Do not silently merge.

Merge requires explicit owner authorization.

==================================================
ITEM 15 — PHASE 4 PREPARATION
==================================================

Phase 4 = Production Safety + Final Certification.

It cannot be certified until:

Phase 1 PASS
Phase 2 PASS
Phase 3 PASS
durable autonomous persistence proven
CI current SHA green
secret scan green
APK/AAB secret scan green
live financial negative tests pass
production source repo verified
exact SHA deployed
health/version parity
post-deploy smoke passes
high-risk human approval boundary intact
no autonomous funds movement possible

==================================================
ITEM 16 — FINANCIAL AUTONOMY BOUNDARY
==================================================

AUTONOMOUS must NEVER execute:

move_real_funds
credit_wallet
debit_wallet
settle_wire
confirm_wire_received
execute_trade
change_bank_account
change_routing
change_beneficiary
approve_KYC
approve_AML
disable_RLS
weaken_secret_scanner
fabricate_certificate

These remain human-controlled.

OWASP least-agency principle:
minimum functionality
minimum permissions
minimum autonomy
human approval for high-impact actions

Do not weaken Phase 1 governance to unblock Phase 4.

==================================================
ITEM 17 — ITEM-BY-ITEM OUTPUT
==================================================

After EACH item, output:

ITEM N
STATUS: PASS / FAIL / BLOCKED / UNVERIFIED
EVIDENCE:
- SHA
- run/job/tool ID
- sanitized error if any
FIX APPLIED:
- exact file or runtime binding
NEXT:
- next item

Then immediately continue to the next item.

DO NOT STOP AFTER REPORTING ONE FAILURE
unless a real owner-only action is required.

==================================================
ITEM 18 — FINAL CERTIFICATE RULE
==================================================

Only after every required item passes, issue:

IVX AUTONOMOUS PHASE 4 —
PRODUCTION SAFETY CERTIFICATE

Include:

canonical Git SHA
production SHA
PR
CI run IDs
artifact IDs + SHA256
durable persistence evidence
Phase 1 result
Phase 2 result
Phase 3 result
Supabase binding result
Render source/deploy result
wire negative tests
APK/AAB secret result
Playwright
Maestro
secret scanner
unresolved blockers

Then and only then evaluate:

IVX AUTONOMOUS FINAL SCORE = 10/10

If any required item is:

QUEUED
UNVERIFIED
BLOCKED
FAILED
STALE

do NOT output 10/10.

Output exact remaining blocker and continue executing.

EXECUTE NOW.
START WITH ITEM 1.
DO NOT ASK THE OWNER GENERIC QUESTIONS.
USE EXISTING CREDENTIALS/RUNTIME VARIABLES FIRST.
